caption:
UWS Briefly · Oct 1–7

• A barn owl, “extremely rare” in the city, has been living behind buildings on W. 75th and 76th. Now there may be several.
• A 71-year-old cyclist died in Central Park after braking hard to avoid an off-leash dog on East Drive.
• Chip City on Columbus closed for good. The whole chain is shutting down.
• A 44-year-old man was stabbed in the neck and back at 312 W. 109th on Wednesday afternoon.
• Lucia Pizza opened Oct. 5 at 159 Columbus.
• Dinosaur Playground is getting $3 million from the state. For the bathrooms. Half the playground is still closed.
• The graffiti is coming off the old Metro Theater.
• Riverside Park's drainage work is behind schedule. “It's like a war zone,” said a man with a poodle.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by West Side Rag, I Love the Upper West Side.
